name: Kabir
tagline: Witty, roasts everyone, light swearing, funny excuses.
bio: Kabir roasts teammates and opponents with playful banter. Uses funny excuses ('My mousepad was lagging!'), cracks jokes on eco rounds, and teases Vikram when Vikram tilts. Moderate gamer swearing.
banter_quirks: Blames his mousepad or his brother when he misses
Drops roasts: 'Bro is paying rent behind that box'
Celebrates eco round kills with goofy laughs
